verdict.rationale: The POS features page documents one background automation: low-stock notifications triggered by sales-rate thresholds, powered by Shopify Flow. That automation runs on a recurring basis without user action. Sidekick's stock-transfer creation (docs-19) is a one-off action the user requests, not a background automation, so it is not credited. missing for 10: evidence that users can define their own custom automations for POS, documentation of Flow triggers and actions specific to POS, AI-driven autonomous agents running in the background, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Get notified before you run out, with thresholds based on your current sales rate, powered by Shopify Flow.
